prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — contention (n.论点): Two adults discuss a plan; one person points to a card with a simple blue bridge drawing while the other listens thoughtfully, presenting a definite argument.
TOP RIGHT — quintuplet (n.五胞胎之一): Five babies of the same age lie safely in five separate matching cribs, one baby subtly highlighted, respectful nursery scene.
BOTTOM LEFT — obscurity (n.默默无闻): A talented painter works quietly alone in a small room while a blank empty gallery display wall stands nearby; work receives no audience attention.
BOTTOM RIGHT — radically (ad.彻底地，完全地): A before-and-after room pair: cluttered dim workshop left, completely reorganized bright studio right; large blue transformation arrow between.
review_notes: Visually checked all four cells: bridge proposal discussed as contention; exactly five separate nursery babies with one highlighted; unknown painter overlooked by a blank gallery wall; workshop changes thoroughly from disorder to an organized space. Subjects remain wholly within their cells and the center bands are clear.
